packet.author_self_check: gfortran -std=f2023 compiled and ran all eight during authoring
packet.author_self_reported_weakness: The author flagged that a comparison of a zero-length substring with an empty literal is weak on its own and that the LEN guards carry those facets.

independent_review.blank_padding_analysis: The reviewer checked every value comparison individually. All nonzero comparisons use equal-length operands, so none can succeed through Fortran's blank padding instead of the property under test. The only padding-weak comparisons are the two against an empty literal, at length_formula line 32 and zero_length line 12, and in both cases the facet is carried by an explicit LEN assertion.
independent_review.zero_length_verdict: Acceptable: the dedicated case asserts LEN of zero, that the parent is unchanged, and that a neighbouring nonzero substring still behaves.
independent_review.sensitivity_verdict: 82 plans per compiler, all 246 runs sensitive, no vacuous mutation found.

evidence.qualifying_reference: GNU Fortran 16.1.0 in f2023 for all eight cases
evidence.target: frozen LFortran 0.65.0-411-ga0afaa840b-dirty; it passes all eight but adjudicates nothing

oracle_judgments: Parents use all-different characters, so an off-by-one starting or ending point changes the observed value.
No character intrinsic such as INDEX, SCAN, TRIM or ADJUSTL is used as the oracle for a substring value; LEN is used only where the facet is about length.
The default facets compare the defaulted form against its explicit equivalent, so they establish the default rule rather than merely a value.
The endpoint facets use integer variables assigned by executed statements, so they concern an evaluated expression rather than a constant.
The zero-length facets rest on LEN of zero plus an unchanged parent and a neighbouring nonzero substring.
explicit_limitations: These eight runs represent exactly the eight facets of one requirement. The 28 remaining 9.4.1 facets under R908, R909, R910, C908 and S9.4.1-002 stay pending, including every diagnostic-control plan.
No linked facet, SourceUse relationship, source closure, baseline entry or universal conformance credit is created.
All three compilers passing is corroboration, not proof: Flang runs f2018 and is supplementary, and the target under test adjudicates nothing.
A comparison of a zero-length substring against an empty literal is not by itself evidence; the LEN assertions carry those facets.

preservation.reason_no_baseline_change: all eight cases pass on the frozen target
